question: Who among the following is an ace pistol shooter?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saurabh Chaudhary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Saurabh Chaudhary** is an Indian sports ace pistol shooter who won a gold medal in the 10 m Air Pistol at the 2018 Asian Games. 
 
• He was the Asian Games' youngest gold medalist from India.
 
• In the ISSF Junior World Cup in Suhl, Germany, he had already won gold medals and set a new junior world record.
 
• He is the first Indian shooter to have won gold in the ISSF World Championship, ISSF World Cup, Youth Olympic Games, Asian Games, and Asian Air Gun Championship.
 
• In January 2020, he earned 63rd gold in men's 10-meter air pistol at the 63rd National Shooting Championship.
